payload.question: How many affordable homes did the council help create?
payload.label: Affordable homes built, bought or enabled, 2024/25
payload.council_caveat: The council's own explanation: "In 2024-25, a total of 48 new affordable homes were completed: 29 homes built by the council at Three Score, five acquired by the council on Barrack Street, and 14 enabled through a grant to a local Registered Provider (RP). Although there has been some delay in development programmes due to Nutrient Neutrality, which prevented us reaching the target of 50 homes, these remaining homes are expected to be delivered over the next two years." The council publishes these numbers as screenshots of a dashboard inside a PDF, so they cannot be read by machine. We read them off the images by eye, which is why this measure is flagged for human checking.
payload.evidence: This is an annual indicator, reported at the end of the year. The council counts homes it built itself, bought, or enabled someone else to provide. Its target is 50 a year and it says it will step in below 45. In 2024/25 it reported 48.
